headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the offense. Harris II hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs in the game. The Cleveland Guardians took down the Detroit Tigers 4-3 in a closely contested game, while the Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Victor Vodnik of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation. The Tampa Bay Rays have also been affected, with Ben Williamson being placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 17, 2026, due to a low back strain. The Chicago White Sox, Houston Astros, Arizona Diamondbacks, Toronto Blue Jays, New York Mets, and Minnesota Twins have also reported injuries to various players.

The Tampa Bay Rays made a key trade addition, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. The Los Angeles Dodgers also made a trade, acquiring LHP Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Chicago White Sox traded CF Junior Perez to the Athletics for LHP Jackson Nove, while the Athletics traded RHP Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for 2B Alika Williams.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians took down the Detroit Tigers 4-3 in a closely contested game. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Kevin Kelly earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Victor Vodnik Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right ulnar nerve inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rays Make Key Trade Addition**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays acquired 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. Dunn joins the Rays' roster in a move that could bolster their infield depth.
